top_strength: Jules gathered comprehensive logistics details methodically (addresses, square footage, stories, furniture inventory, box count, packing status) and delivered the full pricing framing including all-inclusive rates, Value Days savings in dollar amounts, and the no-deposit rate-lock promise.
coaching_note: After the customer raises a concern in step 2, Jules needs to dig two layers deep instead of accepting a surface answer and moving on—and critically, he must never reach step 7 without explicitly asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent, rather than implying it through availability discussion.
